decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - (3)	NON-STD	The noise levels from the proposed roof-top plant (specified as two condenser units) should be inaudible when assessed from the nearest noise sensitive receiver.

Condition : 4 - (4)	NON-STD	The level of noise emitted from the proposed roof-top plant (specified as two air condenser units), shall not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing background noise levels (LAeq) when measured over any 24 hour period from the nearest noise sensitive receiver.
Condition : 5 - (5)	NON-STD 	The structures shall be removed when no longer required for use.
Condition : 6 - (6)	NON-STD 	The advertising sign hereby permitted must not illuminated and must be constructed of material that is non reflective.
description: Installation of 2 - condenser unit to the roof incorporating internal alterations on the 2nd and 3rd floors to existing office building.
